The agency should be responsible for Operation and Maintenance of – Non IBR Boilers, and their a ccessories, a) Operation and Maintenance of 850 Kg/Hr Oil/Gas fired non IBR Steam Boiler and its auxiliaries. – 4 or 5 Nos. b) Operation and Maintenance of Raw water purifying system and Boiler feed water Softner unit o f Resin capacity 800 Ltrs and its auxiliaries. c) To monitor , check, and reusue the condensate water. d) To monitor and check the De-aerator system for water reuse. Normally the operation of the plant will be done in three continuous shifts A, B & C Except Sunday and National Holidays, However in case of any production requirement/ breakdown the contractor should be ready to work on Holidays/Sundays. SCOPE OF WORK The Vendor is responsible to supply 3 Experienced Operators for shift operations and 1 Person in G shift to support Preventive maintenance activities and for relieving purpose. The persons supplied to have in-depth Knowledge in Operation and Maintenance of all the above Utility Equipment. To t roubleshoot the issues faced and have to identify the solution and has to rectify the problems in th e Boiler. 1. The vendor has to ensure the availability of operator for all the shift without any issues. 2. Effective operation and maintenance of steam generating boilers & maintain proper steam press ure and Temperature to all the Plants. 3. All mechanical and electrical related operation and maintenance has to be carried out by the ope rator. 4. Periodical Inspection and PM schedule (Daily/ weekly/ monthly/ annually) to be adhered for boiler, and Softner plant, as per the design requirement mentioned and as per the SOP given. 5. All safety rules and guidelines of factories & Boilers are strictly followed during operation. 6. Chemical cleaning of boiler coil to be done as per schedule and the carbon dusts are to be cleane d periodically from Boiler and chimney. 7. Periodical cleaning (Every week) of steam trap to be done and steam leakages are to be avoided. 8. Operation & maintenance of water softener done regularly and has to be operated as per SOP. 9. Feed water chemical dosing and Cooling Tower water dosing to be done as per requirement. 10. Cleaning and upkeep for of all equipment’s to be followed on daily basis. 11. Pumping of FO/LDO from Storage to Service tank on regular basis as per requirement and maint ain minimum level for uninterrupted operation of boiler 12. The annual manual/chemical cleaning hydraulic test & inspection part etc of those boilers will be executed every year will be in the scope of bidder. Under BL supervision 13. To maintain logbook in all shifts, FO/LDO/LPG Usage, Operational Hours to monitored and maintai n standards as per design.

14. To discuss the status and issues of the utility equipment on daily basis with BL In-charge. 15. Additionally the operator must also operate Air compressor – 4 Nos and cooling tower 2 No based on requirement, in Coordination with BL Shift In-charge. Others · If there is any production loss or quality issues due to mal operation of boiler/air compressor /Cooli ng tower/ softner plant, plant In-charge may impose penalty on contractor. · The contractor should be ready to work on Holidays/Sundays based on requirement to carry out Operation, Major breakdown / Preventive activities. · If there is any damage of machines/property/material due to operator the cost will be deducted fro m the subsequent bills. · The required spare parts & consumables of boiler / softner plant, shall be supplied by BL. Hence ad vance information on spares requirement to be intimated for procurement lead time. · All Tools and tackles required for Operation and maintenance of the above equipments to be provi ded by the Vendor. · Site visit mandatory. 4.
